notes: Fixed Order History truncated to 10 days by relaxing the 1000-order React state limit while keeping localStorage cache size safe. Fixed discount calculation in Day Close report.

history.changes: Fixed Order History truncated to last 10 days (relaxed the 1000-order React state limit while safely caching to 1000 items in local storage). Mapped discount_amount correctly so discounts are tracked properly in Z-Report Day Close view.

Fixed order history sync to correctly parse backend response format.
Resolved critical 'Sync Error' when sending KOT for new Pickup orders. Implemented Category-based KOT Exclusions (Save paper by skipping Water/Beverages). Fixed ReferenceError in navigation cleanup.
Fixed order duplication via WebSocket/Local state reconciliation. Resolved Pickup 'Sync Error' by supporting virtual table IDs in backend. Implemented idempotent Order Deletion.
